preconditions.description: The number of hashtags n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('#' == hashtag[0] for hashtag in hashtags)
preconditions.description: Each hashtag starts with exactly one '#' symbol.
Each hashtag has positive length (at least '#' and one lowercase letter).
The total length of all hashtags (excluding '#') does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n hashtags.

postconditions.expression: all('#' == hashtag[0] for hashtag in result)
postconditions.description: Each output hashtag starts with exactly one '#' symbol.
Each output hashtag has at least the '#' symbol.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] <= result[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The output hashtags are in lexicographical order (non-decreasing).

postconditions.expression: sum(len(hashtags[i]) - len(result[i]) for i in range(n)) == min_deletions
postconditions.description: The total number of deleted characters is minimized, where min_deletions is the smallest possible sum of deletions to achieve lexicographical order.
